name: George E. Stone
bio: George E. Stone (born Gerschon Lichtenstein; May 18, 1903 – May 26, 1967) was a Polish-born American character actor in movies, radio, and television. Description above from the Wikipedia article George E. Stone, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.
place: Lódz, Poland, Russian Empire [now Lódz, Lódzkie, Poland]
